tldr: Alibaba's Qwen team released Qwen-Image-2.1, a 7B open-weight image generation and editing model, in late September; by Oct 7 a hands-on guide covered LoRA fine-tuning for product images. On Oct 9 the eight-step Qwen-Image-2.1-Turbo landed on Hugging Face with a license caveat.
whats_new: Oct 13: an OrcaRouter guide catalogs every Qwen Image release, says which to use, and flags a gap where a 2.5 release would sit.
why_it_matters: An eight-step Turbo variant of a 7B image model cuts per-image latency and GPU cost for self-hosted pipelines, but the license decides whether it can ship commercially.

beats.headline: First hands-on guide: LoRA fine-tuning for product images
Qwen-Image-2.1-Turbo ships on Hugging Face with eight-step generation and a license caveat
OrcaRouter maps every Qwen Image release and the missing 2.5 step

open_questions: Does the Turbo license permit commercial use, given the base weights were reported as research-use only?
Does eight-step Turbo hold output quality against the base model on independent evals?
Do LoRA fine-tunes of the 7B model hold quality on product imagery beyond one walkthrough?
Will Alibaba ship a Qwen Image 2.5 release, and under what license?
take_for_builders: Confirm the license for both base and Turbo weights before any commercial use, then compare eight-step Turbo output against base Qwen-Image-2.1 on your own eval set for quality and latency.
